title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: read-only access to device onboarding with View-Only Device Management
summary: The briefing cannot promise that Devices page access stays unchanged until an administrator assigns the role. Microsoft already lists the role in existing role groups but has not explained whether their members gain access automatically; the default must remain unstated.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The change is admin-opt-in and nothing changes until an administrator assigns the role.
claims.quote: Searched: "View-Only Device Management" "Devices" enable default role groups; "View-Only Device Management" "onboarding" export enable switch default. Read roadmap, device-onboarding-overview and scc-permissions; none says existing role-group members need a new assignment.
claims.fix: Set defaultState to unknown. Replace the summary's 'nothing changes until an administrator assigns it' and equivalent body/risk-rationale assurances with 'Existing administrative roles retain full access; Microsoft has not stated whether existing holders of View-Only Device Management gain Devices page access automatically.' Keep review as a judgement if desired, but do not infer an opt-in rollout from unchanged access for current administrators.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A specific licence or SKU for this planned role is not yet published, so its licensing model is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: "View-Only Device Management" licensing price meter Purview. Opened device-onboarding-overview and Microsoft Purview service description; searched the latter for the role name. No role-specific SKU was stated, but general licensing covers users assigned Purview roles.
claims.fix: Keep licensing.model unknown for the unpublished role-specific SKU, but add: 'Microsoft's general Purview service description says users assigned a Purview role for use in the portal require a licence; the specific licence for this planned access is not yet published.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/office365/servicedescriptions/microsoft-365-service-descriptions/microsoft-365-tenantlevel-services-licensing-guidance/microsoft-purview-service-description#which-users-need-a-license in sources.
